limitations.L1: endovascularly implantable CSF shunt device having a shunt body with first and second ends
limitations.L2: first lumen configured for CSF drainage from subarachnoid space to dural venous sinus
limitations.L3: second lumen distinct from the first lumen, configured for drug delivery into the CSF
limitations.L4: drug delivery lumen fluidly connected to a drug source
limitations.L5: wherein CSF drainage and drug delivery operate independently without cross-contamination
limitations.L6: integrated into eShunt anatomy (dural venous sinus deployment)
limitations.L7: pressure-limiting valve preventing drug backflow into drainage lumen

claim_language_verbatim: An endovascularly implantable CSF shunt device comprising: a shunt body having opposed first and second ends, the first end configured for deployment in a subarachnoid space and the second end configured for deployment in a dural venous sinus; a first lumen within the shunt body configured for cerebrospinal fluid drainage from the subarachnoid space to the dural venous sinus; a second lumen within the shunt body, distinct from the first lumen, configured for drug delivery into the cerebrospinal fluid; wherein the second lumen is fluidly connected to a drug source; and wherein CSF drainage through the first lumen and drug delivery through the second lumen operate independently without cross-contamination; further comprising a pressure-limiting valve preventing drug backflow from the second lumen into the first lumen.
